exploit_name: checkpoint() does not correct effectiveBond downward at year boundaries
description: Inflation decreases at year boundaries, but effectiveBond is not reduced accordingly, leading to incorrectly high rewards.
root_cause: Inflation decreases at year boundaries, but effectiveBond is not reduced accordingly, leading to incorrectly high rewards.
fix_description: Adjust effectiveBond downward when inflation thresholds are crossed during checkpoints.
notes: Over-distribution of rewards at year boundaries when inflation should decrease.
